description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="File complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Ready to file complaint">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStart_File</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustomerStart_File</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FileComplaint_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FileComplaint_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStart_File" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileComplaint_End" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="End_ComplaintFiled"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle product or service complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Log</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Log</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Log_Assign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Log_Assign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assign_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assign_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessComplaint" name="Determine complaint validity and whether a refund is justified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of the decision" messageRef="Message_Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_RefundDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Is a refund justified?" default="Flow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_RefundDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reimbursement_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Continue after refund decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reimbursement_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_MarkResolved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_MarkResolved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Does the customer provide feedback?" default="Flow_NoFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resolved_FeedbackChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackProvided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer satisfaction feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackProvided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseResolved" name="Complaint resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackReceived" name="Feedback received after complaint resolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Log" sourceRef="Start_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Review" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Assess" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_AssessComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Notify" sourceRef="Task_AssessComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_RefundDecision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reimbursement_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_MarkResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolved_FeedbackChoice" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">feedbackProvided = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="End_CaseResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Complaint decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Satisfaction feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
